---
title: "How to Set Keyboard Bindings to Programmer's Dvorak on Ubuntu Using `setxkbmap`"
author: "Galen Seilis"
date: "2024-12-11"
categories: [Ubuntu, setxkbamp, Dvorak, Keyboard Layouts]
---

Changing over to programmer's Dvorak on Ubuntu is really easy:

```bash
setxkbmap -layout us -variant dvp
```

Note that if you want to switch back to US layout, you can just drop the variant:

```bash
setxkbmap -layout us
```

If you want to check what the current layout you are using is, you can run:

```bash
setxkbmap -query
```

That's it!
